name: Role-based clinical access and permissions
description: The system must support different permissions for doctors, nurses, front-desk staff, and administrators so patient data and scheduling actions are handled appropriately.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks who can book appointments or view patient details.
Developer asks about role-specific permissions.
Developer mentions accountability or audit trails for clinical actions.

name: Patient records and appointment history
description: The system must store patient profiles, appointment history, and relevant clinical notes without losing continuity across visits.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about patient records or appointment history.
Developer mentions continuity across visits.
Developer discusses record retention or patient context.

name: Scheduling and resource allocation
description: The system must manage doctor availability, clinic rooms, and appointment slots so bookings are accurate and staff are not overbooked.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks how appointments are booked or assigned.
Developer mentions doctor or room availability.
Developer discusses scheduling conflicts or capacity.

name: Check-in and triage workflow
description: The hospital needs an intake process for arrival, waiting lists, and triage so patients are sorted correctly and staff know who needs attention.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks how patients are checked in or triaged.
Developer mentions waitlists or queue management.
Developer discusses prioritization and patient flow.

name: Follow-up and reminders
description: The system must support reminders, follow-up scheduling, and patient communication to reduce missed appointments and improve continuity of care.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about reminders or follow-up.
Developer mentions no-shows or missed appointments.
Developer discusses patient communication workflows.

name: Reporting and operational visibility
description: The hospital needs visibility into appointment volumes, wait times, no-show rates, and staff or clinic performance to improve operational decisions.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about dashboards or operational metrics.
Developer mentions no-show or throughput reporting.
Developer discusses clinic performance and management visibility.

name: Insurance and billing coordination
description: The hospital may need billing or insurance coordination tied to appointments and treatment records to support financial workflows.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about billing or insurance claims.
Developer mentions invoice or financial coordination.
Developer discusses charge capture for appointments or treatment.

name: Compliance, privacy, and audit requirements
description: The system must satisfy privacy and audit expectations with clear handling of sensitive patient information and clinical actions.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about privacy, audit, or access controls.
Developer mentions compliance or secure handling of clinical data.
Developer discusses patient data protection.

name: Integration with existing hospital systems
description: The solution must work alongside current hospital tools, administrative software, or legacy systems without breaking processes during active operations.
evidenceCriteria: Developer asks about integrations with current systems.
Developer mentions existing software or processes.
Developer discusses operational constraints and system handoffs.
